Primeiro de Agosto|1º Agosto]] (30) (30 Oct–19 May) | longest winless = Sporting (15) (29 Dec–3 Apr) | longest losses = {{Nowrap|(4)''Six teams''}} | matches = 236 | total goals = 491 | prevseason = [[2018 Girabola|2018]] | nextseason = [[2019–20 Girabola|2019–20]] | updated = 19 May 2019 }} The '''2018–19 [[Girabola]]''' was the 41st season of top-tier [[association football|football]] in [[Angola]]. The season was held from 27 October 2018 to 19 May 2019.[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/ango2019.html Angola 2018/19], RSSSF.com The league was contested by 16 teams and the bottom three teams were relegated to the 2020 [[Angolan Provincial Football Stage|Provincial stages]]. In the 13th round match between Saurimo FC and ASA, the home team goal-keeper Anselmo felt confident enough to leave his goal unguarded and shoot a free kick that had been awarded for his team, 25 minutes into the game. His confidence paid off as he scored the only goal in the home team's 1-0 win, something unheard of in Angolan football.{{cite web |url=http://www.angop.ao/angola/pt_pt/noticias/desporto/2019/0/4/Girabola2018-Saurimo-ASA-ficha-tecnica,903ea6f0-3709-4a8f-9aca-94c41a7491c5.html |title=Girabola2018/19: Saurimo FC - ASA (ficha técnica) |publisher=ANGOP Angolan News Agency |date=21 Jan 2019 |access-date= 22 Jan 2019 |language=pt}} ==Teams== A total of 16 teams contested the league, including 13 sides from the [[2018 Girabola|2018 season]] and three promoted from the [[2018 Segundona]] - [[Atlético Sport Aviação|ASA]], [[Saurimo FC]] ''(ex-Bikuku FC)'' and [[Santa Rita de Cássia FC|Santa Rita de Cássia]]. On the other hand, [[Domant FC]], [[J.G.M. A.S.C. Huambo|J.G.M.]] and [[Estrela Clube Primeiro de Maio|Primeiro de Maio]] were the last three teams of the [[2018 Girabola|2018 season]] and played in their respective provincial leagues seeking qualification for the [[2019–20 Segundona|2019–20 2nd division qualifiers]]. [[C.D. Primeiro de Agosto|Clube Desportivo Primeiro de Agosto]] were the defending champions from the [[2018 Girabola|2018 season]]. ==Changes from 2018 season== '''Relegated''': [[Domant FC]], [[J.G.M. A.S.C. Huambo|J.G.M.]], [[Estrela Clube Primeiro de Maio|Primeiro de Maio]]
'''Promoted''': [[Atlético Sport Aviação|ASA]], [[Saurimo FC]] (''ex-Bikuku FC''), [[Santa Rita de Cássia FC|Santa Rita de Cássia]] ==FAF penalties== * As a result of a [[Match fixing|match-fixing]] investigation launched by the [[Angolan Football Federation]] (FAF) on the 17th round match between Desportivo da Huila and 1º de Agosto, each team forfeited 3 points and a $5,000 fine.{{cite web |url=http://www.angop.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2019/3/14/Agosto-Club-express-outrage-appeal-against-Federation-decision,b0be1c85-8ceb-487b-be70-1225361bf3b5.html |title=1º de Agosto Club express outrage, to appeal against Federation's decision |publisher=ANGOP Angolan News Agency |date=2 Apr 2019}} * Kabuscorp do Palanca forfeited 9 points, for failing to address payment claims by a total 6 former employees (including players, technical and medical staff), following a 15-day deadline stipulated by FAF. * Bravos do Maquis forfeited 3 points, for failing to address payment claims by former player Silvino Assete, following a 15-day deadline stipulated by FAF. ==FIFA penalty== The Angolan Football Federation was instructed by FIFA to relegate Kabuscorp for failing to meet payment claims by former player [[Rivaldo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.kingfut.com/2019/05/03/kabuscorp-sport-clube-do-palanca-relegation/ |title=FIFA: Angola's Kabuscorp Sport Clube do Palanca to suffer relegation |publisher=Kingfut.com |date=3 May 2019}}{{cite web |url=http://www.angop.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2019/4/19/Sports-Ministry-requests-FAF-intervene-Kabuscorp-FIFA-sanction,c51f1260-efa2-4be8-9ff5-7320e0434d7f.html |title=Sports Ministry requests FAF to intervene in Kabuscorp's FIFA sanction |publisher=ANGOP Angolan News Agency |date=6 May 2019}} Even though the debt has reportedly been paid in full, Kabuscorp failed to pay within the established deadline. The club faced a second relegation penalty regarding their dispute with [[TP Mazembe]]{{cite web |url=http://www.angop.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2019/4/22/Angolan-Football-Federation-relegates-Kabuscorp-second-division,ef06504f-2d62-464c-aa58-60f86717b151.html |title=Angolan Football Federation relegates Kabuscorp to second division |publisher=ANGOP Angolan News Agency |date=30 May 2019 |access-date= 31 May 2019 }}{{cite web |url=http://faf.co.ao/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/CO-022-SG-2019-1.pdf |title=Comunicado Oficial Nº22/19 |publisher=faf.co.ao |access-date= 6 Jun 2019 |language=pt}} ==Stadiums and locations== {{Location map+ |Angola |width=450 |float=right |caption={{pad|10em}}Locations of the 2019 Girabola teams |places= {{Location map~ |Angola |lat=-5.55525 |long=12.185758 |label=[[Sporting Clube de Cabinda|Sporting]] |position=right}} {{Location map~ |Angola |lat=-8.969852 |long=13.283587 |label=[[C.D.
